name: orka
description: Search Orka context, manage project knowledge and reviews, install complete skills, and diagnose local synchronization.

interface.longDescription: Search accessible project resources, inspect revision history, save memories, update plans, and manage permissions and requests within your Orka authority. Use account in Orka and approve the displayed account and scopes to use local discovery, skill installation, and sync recovery. Local tools verify a short-lived connection proof; account or service changes require explicit reconnection. Browser-only connections retain remote access. Writes and administration require explicit OAuth consent; existing read-only connections retain their limits. ENV content is excluded.
defaultPrompt: Find the shared context and skills relevant to my project.
Save this decision to Orka and update the project plan.
Check this project’s sync health and pending requests.
